prompt:
## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Membership Number
where: MemberRepository (uses), src/persistence/memberRepository.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
return this.members.get(membershipNumber);
=====SOURCE-END=====
graph:
- class MemberRepository (node 1cdbf101edd01700): layer infrastructure, component persistence, fan-out 0, fan-in 5
- <- CALLS Method ClubService.addMember
- <- CALLS Method ClubService.listMembers
- <- CALLS Method RinkService.purchase
- <- CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS Class ClubService
- <- CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS Class RinkService

### B
concept: Membership
where: RinkService (uses), src/business/rinkService.ts, component business
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
if (typeof memberNo !== "string" || !this.members.get(memberNo)) {
        throw new DomainError("validation", "unknown membership number");
      }
=====SOURCE-END=====
graph:
- class RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1): layer domain, component business, fan-out 22, fan-in 0
- -> CALLS Method BookingRepository.create
- -> CALLS Method BookingRepository.get
- -> CALLS Method BookingRepository.list
- -> CALLS Method BookingRepository.listBySession
- -> CALLS Method BookingRepository.update
- -> CALLS Method ClubBookingRepository.listByDate
- -> CALLS Method HireStockRepository.all
- -> CALLS Method HireStockRepository.get

response.rationale: A is 'Membership Number', the key used to look up a member: MemberRepository does `return this.members.get(membershipNumber);`. B is 'Membership', the member or membership record itself. RinkService checks that a membership exists with `!this.members.get(memberNo)` and throws "unknown membership number" when it does not. The number is an attribute of the membership. The two are closely linked, but sharing an id is not enough to make them the same concept, so I treat them as different.
